name: Architect

google_prefill.phone: [G] the listed phone (stays the business's; customers use Rosie's one number)

A.flow: A: the customer comes to the business (video or phone count as A)

services.name: Design consult, one room
services.story: The main story: a design consult for one room at the studio, $35. A card is saved for the $20 fee; Alex pays the $35 at the front desk after the consult.

services.name: Video design review, one room
services.story: A video design review of one room, $55, paid in full when booking.

services.name: Schematic design review
services.story: A schematic design review at the studio: a $40 deposit when booking, the $100 rest at the desk when the drawings are picked up.

services.name: Design quoted from photos
services.story: A design quoted from photos: a $20 deposit once the quote is OK'd; the rest is billed when the drawings are sent.

services.name: Design quote from photos, free
services.story: A quote from photos, free: nothing taken, nothing charged.

B.flow: B: the business goes to the customer

services.name: Home site visit and measure
services.story: The main story: a site visit and measure for 5 rooms, $179 with the travel fee. A card is saved for the $89 fee; Rosie texts the bill after the visit.

services.name: Design phase at home
services.story: A design phase at home: $150, a $40 deposit when booking, the $110 rest charged to the saved card at DONE.

services.name: Permit-drawing review at home
services.story: A permit-drawing review at home, $75, paid in full when booking.

services_shape: a design consult and review at the studio (flow A), and site visits and design work at the customer's place (flow B); a video or photo review counts as flow A
questions_before_times: What kind of work: a room, a kitchen, an addition, a whole house, or a permit set?
Is there a site plan, photos or a survey already? Yes, no or not sure.
What's the goal: a new room, a sale, a permit, or repairs?
At the studio, at the customer's place, or by video?
safety_stop: someone hurt, or a fire or smoke at the place (call 911)
a structure that looks unsafe to stand in (call 911 if someone is in it)
license: An architect's state license, where the state requires one for the drawings. Each architect's own license, and the firm's registration where the state asks: the owner's own papers, shown as given, never checked by Rosie (D96).
